summary: Greg Brockman was Stripe's first CTO before co-founding OpenAI in 2015 with Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Ilya Sutskever and others; he is its president and in 2026 took over much of its day-to-day product work. He briefly quit in November 2023 when the board ousted Altman and returned with him. In 2025–26 he and his wife became major political donors to Trump's super PAC and to the pro-AI super PAC Leading the Future.
